reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: I’ve had Rakuten tv app on my 2017 iPad for years, now it’s not good enough due to being incapable of updating to IOS 17. Where’s all my historical files and purchases gone to? Not happy

reviews.title: Poor show!
reviews.text: I’ve been purchasing films on Rakuten now for over 6years and have required a reasonable library but unfortunately about 2 months ago I have not been able to watch them on my phone and there is no explanation as to why!

reviews.title: Library change
reviews.text: Not sure when they updated the app, but the library is poorly played out and having to scroll through a singular line that is slow to update is very poor. Go back to the whole page for personal library and also give back the quick link to downloads.

reviews.title: Was good, now just RUBBISH
reviews.text: They had a good app for Apple TV, now you can only watch free movies. Any paid movies can only be watched on devices and airplay is NOT supported anymore! What are they thinking?! So bad.

reviews.title: Update????
reviews.text: Since the update of 8/1/2026, app won’t open. Fix it please. Thank you.

reviews.title: Buggiest Streamer
reviews.text: Not sure how or why this app fails to do what every other streamer can do. Download offline is buggy af, loses progress each time and if you get signal whilst watching offline the app just crashes. I’ve also tried many times to chromecast or airplay to no avail. Avoid Rakuten.

reviews.title: What a load of rubbish
reviews.text: What a load of rubbish!! Couldn’t share on my tv

reviews.title: No AirPlay
reviews.text:
The mobile app has no implementation of AirPlay (it used to, but it was removed without warning), so I’m unable to cast from my phone to my Apple TV, and the Apple TV app does not allow you to sign in to your  account, so you can’t play any of the media you have bought. 

Overall a very poor experience. Please either bring back airplay or accounts in the Apple TV app

reviews.title: Apps are awful
reviews.text: Both the TV app and phone apps are terrible. The TV app is extremely poor quality with frequent artifacting throughout. The iPhone app is awful too, neither airplay or Google casting work at all. If I didn’t get free rentals from my energy company I would never use Rakuten and will never pay for a rental from them when they are the worst option available by far.

reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text:
Price - I had a voucher, and looked at watching one film. If you go on the website, the renting price was 50p less than what was stated on the app.
Watching - when watching the film, it was glitchy throughout the film, even though it is a very recent film release. It was that it needed to buffer, it sound static every 10 seconds which made the watching of the film frustrating
